story.title: Nvidia Board Uninterested in Jensen Huang's Return Amid Support from Trump
story.summary: The Nvidia board has reportedly expressed no interest in reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO or in any other role at the company. This comes as a campaign to bring Huang back gains traction, with support from several tech figures and notable endorsements, including comments from Donald Trump, who stated he would not mind Huang's return. Huang was ousted following allegations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.

explore_lenses.label: What actually changed at Nvidia?
explore_lenses.title: A resignation and interim succession
explore_lenses.summary: The confirmed corporate record is that Huang resigned from his executive and board roles; Nvidia installed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO and began a permanent CEO search. That is more precise than characterizing the move as a completed board firing.

claims.text: Nvidia said on November 12 that Jensen Huang resigned immediately as president, CEO and a board member, and that Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO while retaining her CFO role.
The company said its board would consider both internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO job; its current management page lists Huang as a founder, not an officer.

Before Huang's resignation, the board said an independent-director committee supported by outside counsel would investigate reports of a foreign-intelligence effort, while stating it had no reason at that point to believe Nvidia secrets or national security had been compromised.

points: Nvidia said on November 12 that Jensen Huang resigned immediately as president, CEO and a board member, and that Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO while retaining her CFO role.
The company said its board would consider both internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO job; its current management page lists Huang as a founder, not an officer.

Before Huang's resignation, the board said an independent-director committee supported by outside counsel would investigate reports of a foreign-intelligence effort, while stating it had no reason at that point to believe Nvidia secrets or national security had been compromised.
explore_lenses.uncertainty_note: Nvidia has not publicly detailed the basis for Huang's resignation, the investigation's findings, or a timetable for naming a permanent CEO.

explore_lenses.label: What happens next procedurally?
explore_lenses.title: Board search, review and public scrutiny
explore_lenses.summary: The immediate formal processes are the board's CEO search and its independent investigation, with Kress running the company in the interim. A petition or presidential comments can add pressure, but Nvidia's board retains the decision-making role described in the company's succession announcement.

claims.text: Nvidia has formally started a permanent-CEO search and says Kress will remain interim CEO until a successor is named.
The previously announced investigation is overseen by a committee of independent directors with outside independent counsel, and Nvidia said it would provide updates as appropriate.
Nvidia scheduled its fiscal third-quarter 2027 results release and earnings call for November 17, creating the first scheduled public company event after Huang's departure.
Reuters reported that Huang's prospective congressional testimony and unresolved investigations could complicate the succession process; this is a reported outlook, not a company forecast.

story_report.summary: Nvidia’s board is not interested in bringing Jensen Huang back, according to reports, even as a campaign for his reinstatement draws support from technology figures and Donald Trump says he would not mind Huang’s return. Nvidia has instead installed Colette Kress as interim chief executive and begun a search for a permanent successor, leaving the company’s leadership transition on a separate track from the public push for Huang.

sections.heading: Nvidia CEO Transition Details
sections.body: Nvidia said Huang resigned immediately on November 12 as president, chief executive and board member. Kress, who remains chief financial officer, was named interim CEO until a successor is appointed. The board said it would consider internal and external candidates for the permanent position, while Nvidia’s management page now identifies Huang as a founder rather than an officer.

sections.heading: Nvidia Investigation and Return Campaign
sections.body: Before Huang resigned, Nvidia said a committee of independent directors, supported by outside counsel, would investigate reports of a foreign-intelligence effort. The company said at that time it had no reason to believe Nvidia secrets or national security had been compromised. Separately, the campaign urging Huang’s reinstatement has won backing from technology figures, while Trump has said he would not mind his return.

sections.heading: Nvidia Succession Process Ahead
sections.body: Kress is to remain interim CEO while the board conducts its permanent-chief-executive search. Nvidia scheduled its fiscal third-quarter 2027 results release and earnings call for November 17, its first scheduled public company event after Huang’s departure. Reuters reported that prospective congressional testimony by Huang and unresolved investigations could complicate succession, an outlook that was not presented as a company forecast.

unresolved.text: Nvidia has not publicly detailed the basis for Huang’s resignation, the findings of the investigation or when it will name a permanent CEO.
There is no public deadline for the investigation or for a decision on whether Huang could return in another capacity.
